facts: NIOSH archived table entry for hydrogen peroxide (solution 30%–70%) lists the 8‑hour recommended protective‑clothing barriers as: Butyl; Natural; Nitrile; PE; Viton; CPF3; Responder; Tychem.
NIOSH archived table entry for hydrogen peroxide (solution 30%–70%) lists the 4‑hour recommended protective‑clothing barriers as: PVC; PE/EVAL.
payload.query: For hydrogen peroxide solution from 30 to 70 percent, which barriers does the archived NIOSH table place in its 8-hour group and which in its 4-hour group?
payload.answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NIOSH archived table entry for hydrogen peroxide (solution 30%–70%) lists the 8‑hour recommended protective‑clothing barriers as: Butyl; Natural; Nitrile; PE; Viton; CPF3; Responder; Tychem. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective Clothing A-Z | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- NIOSH archived table entry for hydrogen peroxide (solution 30%–70%) lists the 4‑hour recommended protective‑clothing barriers as: PVC; PE/EVAL. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective Clothing A-Z | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
